answer: Reputation Decay Escrow. Each identity posts an ember of escrow that decays with inactivity; reputation climbs a spiral only through sustained, verified transactions. Reaching a useful zenith requires months of costly participation. An attacker spawning N identities pays N escrows plus the full time-and-fee cost of maintaining each reputation above decay, so marginal identities stay worthless—making mass duplication economically irrational rather than merely blocked.
